title: Do these 4 every day this week while dinner cooks
caption: Kitchen workout while dinner cooks: four moves, eight minutes, one wall. Wall Push-Up, Wall Sit, Standing Hip Hinge and Reverse Lunge, all quiet enough for a sleeping kid in the next room. Save this for the next twenty minutes at the stove.

overlays.text: Do these 4 every day this week while dinner cooks.
Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower slow, press yourself away.
Wall Sit. 30 seconds. Back flat on the wall, knees bent, hold while it simmers.
Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Push your hips back, flat back, stand tall again.
Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, drop the knee, stand back up.
No pull and no core this week. Both come back next week, away from the stove.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete. So is eight.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the four. Eight minutes, and the oven is your timer.

scenes.footer: Save this for the next twenty minutes at the stove.
